name: Particle-Based Convective Cloud Simulation (Neyret)
definition: One of the earliest works to obtain a simulation of convective clouds based on high-level physics variables, modeling parcels as 2D particles (bubbles).
summary: Particle-Based Convective Cloud Simulation models cumulus clouds as 2D bubbles using buoyancy and condensation, distinguishing itself by explicitly simulating mixing, attraction, and vortices for enhanced small-scale detail.
